title: ContextForgeEvidence
description: Sanitized evidence statement, proof references, and verification digest.

statement.description: Human or code statement proving the claim without secrets or raw conversational dumps.

authority_level.description: Numeric priority ranking (100 = User Explicit, 80 = Current Code AST, 40 = Agent Observation).

source_refs.description: List of path:line pointers or commit references.

digest.description: Cryptographic or content digest of the observed evidence.

observed_commit.description: Full Git commit SHA at which evidence was captured.

producer.description: Producer tool or human authoring this evidence.
